summary: Hardcoded WebLogic admin password 'weblogic1' in ear/pom.xml <weblogic.local.password> property (legacy source, auto-deploy profile). Should be removed or moved to CI env vars before any deployment pipeline reuse.

Log4j 1.x (log4j:1.2.17 + slf4j-log4j12:1.7.21) present in legacy EAR module with scope=provided. Log4j 1.x reached EOL in 2015 and has multiple unpatched CVEs (CVE-2019-17571, deserialization RCE). Not carried forward into the Spring Boot kitchensink module, but the legacy pom should be noted.

No auth downgrade. Original app had no application-level security constraints (web.xml contained no security-constraint elements, no @RolesAllowed). Spring Boot migration correctly omits Spring Security — consistent with source baseline, not a downgrade.
H2 datasource uses username=sa with empty password. Acceptable for in-memory dev/test DB; would need replacement with real credentials before any production deployment target.
